app.title: Electric workshop
app.boardSvgAria: Circuit board; drag parts and connect pins.

styles.title: Part style lab
styles.description: Compare part visual styles here; the chosen look will become the default in the workshop.

palette.hintAcSupply: House wiring: connect line (L) to neutral (N) through loads.
palette.hintDcSupply: Bench parts: use wires between pins to build a DC circuit.
palette.hintAcParts: Click a pin, choose wire color, then click the other pin. Click a wire to select it (Alt+click to delete). Double-click a selected wire to add a bend on the grid; drag blue points to route. Hover a part for remove and switch/breaker controls.
palette.hintDcParts: Click a pin, choose wire color, then click the other pin. Click a wire to select it (Alt+click to delete). Double-click a selected wire to add a bend on the grid; drag blue points to route. Hover a part for remove and switch On/Off.

wire.selectWire: Select wire to edit path. Alt+click to remove.
wire.selectedRouted: Selected wire; double-click path to add a point, drag points to move.

partView.switchOnAria: Switch is on. Click to turn off.
partView.switchOffAria: Switch is off. Click to turn on.
partView.breakerOnAria: Breaker is on. Click to turn off.
partView.breakerOffAria: Breaker is off. Click to turn on.
partView.rotateAria: Rotate part; drag while holding, release to set angle

settings.actionsSelectAria: Position of remove and switch controls

sim.testOff: Test is off. Turn on Test to check the circuit.
sim.dcAddBattery: Add a battery to form a complete loop.
sim.dcNoPath: No complete path from battery positive to negative. Check wires and switches.
sim.dcComplete: Complete loop: conventional current flows from positive to negative.
sim.acAddInlet: Add an AC supply (L and N) to form a complete path from line to neutral.
sim.acNoPath: No complete path from line (L) to neutral (N). Check wires, breaker, and switch.
sim.acComplete: Complete loop: line (L) to neutral (N) path complete (house wiring model).
